skills.group.help: Manage updates of the third-party skill sources.
skills.list.help: List the third-party sources with the active version, the newest one seen and the changelog link.
skills.error.state_invalid: The third-party state file {path} is invalid ({why}).
skills.check.help: Check the registries for newer versions of the third-party sources.
skills.check.daily: Session-start mode: do nothing unless a day has passed, and print the hook JSON only when an update is available.
skills.decline.help: Record that the newest version of a source was declined, so it is not offered again.
skills.decline.source: The source name (rea, agent-skills or wev-skills).
skills.error.nothing_to_decline: No newer version of {name} has been seen yet; run `wev skills check` first.
skills.hook.updates: Third-party skill updates are available: {items}. Ask the person once whether to update; on yes run `wev skills update <source>`; on no run `wev skills decline <source>`.
